title: Run-length encoding
prompt:
Write run_length_encode(text) that compresses repeated neighbouring characters into the character followed by how many times it repeats.
Example: 'aaabcc' -> 'a3b1c2'. An empty text gives ''.
hints: Read 'aaabcc' aloud: three a's, one b, two c's. What do you need to remember while you read?
Remember the current character and how many times you've seen it in a row. When the next character differs, what do you do with what you remembered?

Plan: handle empty text; start with the first character and count 1; for each later character: same -> count + 1; different -> write the character and count to the result and start over; after the loop, don't forget to write the last group.

edge_hints.single: One character is one group: the loop body never runs, so the last group must still be written after the loop.
